IN-GAME SERVER RULES
Failure to follow these rules may result in a Kick or Permanent Ban. We want this server to be competitive, chaotic, and fun without becoming miserable for everyone involved. Use common sense, respect the community, and don't be a shit-head.
NO CHEATING & EXPLOITS - This shouldn't even have to be stated.
No cheating, hacking, or exploiting bugs/glitches to gain an unfair advantage.
Do not intentionally abuse any known exploits.
Do not joke about cheating or exploiting. We take these reports seriously and will not hesitate to kick or ban players when necessary.
Bulkhead is already actively working to identify and remove cheaters. Please help them by reporting suspicious players through the in-game reporting system.
How to Report a Player: While in game Tab → Scoreboard → Right Click Player → Report

Bulkhead will handle investigations and enforcement regarding cheating.

Server admins reserve the right to remove or ban players we reasonably believe are cheating or exploiting. This is necessary to protect the integrity of the server and prevent accusations or exploit abuse from putting the server itself at risk.
NO GRIEFING
Do not intentionally engage in behavior designed solely to prevent other players from playing the game. This includes:
Ramming Vehicles
Do not intentionally ram helicopters or vehicles inside your own HQ.
Do not intentionally cause friendly vehicles to crash, explode, or otherwise become unusable.
Do not intentionally fly/drive vehicles from HQ with sole intent to ram enemy vehicles to destroy them.
Destroying Friendly Crates
Do not destroy player-placed crates by the vendor. We understand that players may have different opinions about this, it does not give you permission to destroy them.
HQ Camping
Do not camp outside the enemy faction HQ with vehicles in a way that prevents players from leaving their base.
Do not establish anti-air FOBs immediately outside an enemy HQ for the purpose of repeatedly killing players as they leave.
Anti-Air and fighting in No Man's Land is fine, but they must be positioned a reasonable distance away from the enemy HQ.

Give players ample opportunity to leave their base and reach the Combat Zone. We all love a good heli dogfight and hunting artillery. Chasing someone all the way back to their HQ and then sitting outside waiting for them to leave is not that.
Repeated Team Killing
Repeated or intentional team killing will not be tolerated. Accidental team kills happen. If you accidentally TK someone, own it and move on.
Kill Farming
Do not intentionally revive an enemy player solely to kill them again repeatedly. (Exhibit A: Revive → Kill → Revive → Kill )
 
RESPECTFUL CHAT & VOIP
Friendly banter and competition between teammates & factions is fine. Being an asshole for the sake of being an asshole is not.
Rage baiting and excessive harassment is not welcome.
Do not intentionally dogpile, bully, or repeatedly target another player through chat or VOIP.
Do not harass players because of their skill level or playstyle.
Absolutely no racism, slurs, hate speech, or discrimination of any kind.

These rules apply to All Chat, Team Chat, and VOIP. If someone is being inappropriate or violating these rules, do not turn it into a public argument. Report them through ⁠support-or-report and let the admins handle it. If an admin is not currently online, please provide screenshots, clips, or other evidence whenever possible.
NO STREAM SNIPING
NO ADMIN IMPERSONATING
ADMIN ACTIONS
Admins may issue:
Warnings
Kicks
Temporary bans
Permanent bans

A kick is a warning—not an invitation to immediately rejoin and continue the behavior. If you are kicked from the server, take the hint. Do not rejoin and continue causing problems. Doing so will result in a permanent ban. Admins reserve the right to take action against behavior that violates the spirit of these rules, even if a specific situation is not explicitly listed.

REPORTING PLAYERS
If you believe someone is violating the rules, Please use ⁠support-or-report 
When possible, include:
Player name
What happened
Screenshots
Video clips
Any other relevant information

There is typically an admin available while the server is active, and we will review reports as quickly as possible. Please do not start witch hunts, publicly accuse players, or attempt to enforce the rules yourself. Let the admins handle it.

HAVE FUN!
At the end of the day, we're all here to play WARDOGS, shoot at each other, blow things up, and have a good time. Our community is growing, and we'd love for you to continue being a part of it. 
Play hard. Talk your shit. Have fun. Just don't ruin the game for everyone else.

Welcome to the server.
